paragraphs.text: The Wizards' War was Lim-Dûl 's second campaign to dominate Shandalar and was fought against the five wizard schools founded by The Guardian .

The details of the war are not well established, but it is known that all five guildlords and The Guardian , whose names have all been lost to time, participated in the war. The Black Guildlord was killed during this war, while the others survived. Although Lim-Dûl had amassed great power and had almost conquered all of Shandalar during Lim-Dûl's War many years earlier, this time he was hopelessly outmatched against the defenders of the plane.

Upon Lim-Dûl's defeat, the Guardian removed the necromancer's soul from Azar ’s body and imprisoned it within a magical artifact called the Chain Veil . This allowed the Great Barrier , now powered by Lim-Dûl's soul, to remain intact. There, Lim-Dûl would slumber for almost a thousand years, until a promising necromancer named Liliana Vess , lured by Lim-Dûl's whispers, claimed the relic in her quest for power. Meanwhile, Azar's soulless corpse was reanimated as the lichlord Skavius Slan , who took up the vacant position of the black guild's guildlord.
